lesson.subtitle: Lesson 9 -- Family, Home and Free Time: Your Life, Not Your Work
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Leão | Lesson 9 -- Family, Home and Free Time
lesson.grammar_point: third person singular -s in the present simple

listenings.text: Here is my family, quickly. My husband is a teacher. He works at a school ten minutes from our house. He walks there every day, in the rain and in the sun. My daughter is nineteen. We only see her at the weekend, because she studies medicine in another city. And not every weekend. My son is fourteen, and he lives with us. He plays football. He is not very good, and he says it is always the referee's fault. And the dog. The dog does nothing all day, and he is never tired. That is my family. And you? Tell me about your family.

What do we do at the weekend? Not much, and that is the idea. On Saturday morning my wife goes to the market. It is always the same market. She is there for an hour, and she only buys four things, because she talks to everybody there. I am at home with the children. In the afternoon we are together, the four of us. We do something simple. My son wants the beach, every time. My daughter wants the cinema, every time. One week we go to the beach. The next week we go to the cinema. Nobody is happy, and everybody comes. On Sunday we do nothing at all. That is my favorite day.

extra_audio.text: I have two children. My son is fourteen and he plays football. My daughter is nineteen and she studies in another city. At the weekend we are together. And you? Do you have children?
